rules.label: Rolling Return
rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio
rules.description: Fund Sharpe Ratio must exceed Benchmark Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan marginally outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 0.65% (14.48% vs 13.83%).
Only 46.3% of rolling windows beat the benchmark — weak relative consistency.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.64 vs 0.55) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.97, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 1.71% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.43).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-37.57% vs -37.92%).
Rolling return range spans 1.17% to 25.54% (24.37 pp spread) — consistency score 68.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
